name: hevy-mcp

scripts.dev: bun run catalog:prepare && bunx wrangler dev
scripts.deploy: bun run catalog:prepare && bunx wrangler deploy
scripts.deploy:dry-run: bun run catalog:prepare && bunx wrangler deploy --dry-run
scripts.test: bun run catalog:prepare && node --test test/*.node.mjs && bunx vitest run
scripts.check: bun run test && bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run check:package && bun run deploy:dry-run

description: Single-owner Hevy MCP server for Cloudflare Workers
author: Igal Tabachnik
